disparadores.definicion: CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[ActualizacionGrupo] ON [dbo].[grupos] FOR INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	IF EXISTS ( 		SELECT TOP(1) 0 FROM ws_cloud 	) 	BEGIN 		IF EXISTS ( 			SELECT TOP(1) 0 FROM inserted 		) 		BEGIN 			IF EXISTS ( 				SELECT TOP(1) 0 FROM deleted 			) 			BEGIN 				;WITH cte_ins AS ( 					SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS N, idgrupo, descripcion, clasificacion FROM inserted 				),  				cte_del AS ( 					SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS N, idgrupo, descripcion, clasificacion FROM deleted 				) 				INSERT INTO HistorialActualizaciones(IdActual, IdAnterior, Nombre, Clasificacion, TipoOperacion, Entidad) ( 					SELECT i.idgrupo, d.idgrupo, i.descripcion, i.clasificacion, 'U', 'GRUPOS' 					FROM cte_ins AS i 					INNER JOIN cte_del AS d ON d.N=i.N 					WHERE i.idgrupo <> d.idgrupo OR  					i.descripcion <> d.descripcion OR i.clasificacion <> d.clasificacion 				); 			END 			ELSE 			BEGIN 				INSERT INTO HistorialActualizaciones(IdActual, Nombre, Clasificacion, TipoOperacion, Entidad) ( 					SELECT i.idgrupo, i.descripcion, i.clasificacion, 'I', 'GRUPOS' 					FROM inserted AS i 				); 			END; 		END 		ELSE 		BEGIN 			INSERT INTO HistorialActualizaciones(IdAnterior, TipoOperacion, Entidad) ( 				SELECT d.idgrupo, 'D', 'GRUPOS' 				FROM deleted AS d 			); 		END; 	END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[ax_productos_trigger] ON [dbo].[productos] AFTER UPDATE, DELETE AS BEGIN 	SET NOCOUNT ON; 	IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM inserted) 	BEGIN 		UPDATE ax SET ax.NsId=(SELECT TOP(1) idproducto FROM inserted) FROM AxClaves AS ax INNER JOIN deleted AS d ON ax.NsId=d.idproducto WHERE ax.Tipo=2; 	END 	ELSE 	BEGIN 		DELETE FROM ax FROM AxClaves AS ax INNER JOIN deleted AS d ON ax.NsId=d.idproducto WHERE ax.Tipo=2; 	END END
